passages.title: Country Houses and City Houses
passages.text:
Country houses and city houses have many differences. A country house is usually big. It often has a large garden and a yard in front of the door. Inside, the rooms are very spacious. The living room is the centre of the house. People put a big wooden table and many chairs in the dining room for big family meals.
A city house is different. It is usually tall and narrow. City houses do not have big gardens. The rooms are smaller. Because the space is small, people often put their chest of drawers under the stairs or put the bed next to the wardrobe. Flats are also common in cities. In a flat, all the rooms are on one floor.

An underground house has similar rooms to a normal house. There is a living room, a kitchen, and a bathroom. But the design is different. You cannot have a big window on the wall because there is earth outside. The rooms get light from special windows on the roof.
The furniture is unique, too. In the bedroom, the bed is often in the middle of the room. The wardrobe and bookshelves are not separate. Builders carve them into the walls. Living underground is a very interesting experience.
